CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : M/s. Suraj Kishore Prasad, Advocate For the State : M/s. Shailendra Kumar Tiwari, A.P.P.
-----
02/13.09.2024 Heard the parties Petitioner has been made accused in connection with G.R. Case No. 2692/2023 arising out of Namkum P.S. Case No. 335/2023, for the offences registered under Sections 467, 468, 471, 406, 420 and 120(B) of the I.P.C. and under Section 66(C) and 66(D) of the I.T. Act, pending in the Court of Ms. Ekta Saxena, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Ranchi.
Bail application of the petitioner was earlier rejected by this court vide B.A. No. 10684 of 2023 by order dated 11.03.2024.

On 22.06.2023, Namkum Police received information from Shastri Nagar Branch of S.B.I., New Delhi that proceeds of Cybercrime was deposited in S.B.I. A/C No. 41995042704 in the name of Archana Kumari in S.B.I., Namkum Branch.
The matter was enquired into and Archana Kumari was apprehended.
It appears that Rs. 5,30,000/- which was proceeds of cybercrime was deposited in the account of Sunil Kumar Prajapati vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...

1 one co-accused / witness Archana Kumari.
She has stated that her account was used by the petitioner along with others.
It was submitted by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner that the petitioner is 40% disabled and as such, he should be released on bail.

Considering the fact that the witness Archana Kumari, as submitted by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner, has specifically stated that Rs. 5,30,000/- which was proceeds of cyber offence was deposited in her account by the petitioner and other co-accused persons, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail stands rejected.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Nandini/-
